name: Vapormint bundled media runtime
note: Single source of truth for the private media runtime assembled into runtime/win32-x64/.
The runtime dir is gitignored; this file (and the assembly script) are the auditable record.
To update a tool: bump the version/url here, re-run scripts/build-runtime, then rebuild the installer.
Versions below are what was ACTUALLY verified running on 2026-11-13 (ffmpeg -version, yt-dlp --version, python -V, pip dist-info).

ffmpeg.name: FFmpeg / FFprobe
ffmpeg.distribution: BtbN full GPL static build (win64) — n9.0.1-29-gad500d59cb-20260913
ffmpeg.url_note: We mirror the exact BtbN build as a release asset on OUR repo. BtbN's 'latest' tag is a moving target that drifts, and BtbN prunes old autobuild releases after ~2 weeks (the original Sept 2026 release is gone upstream). Pointing at our own asset makes the build bit-for-bit reproducible forever and immune to upstream pruning. The mirror zip contains ONLY the files the runtime ships (ffmpeg.exe, ffprobe.exe + the 7 av*/sw* DLLs), so it is 74 MB rather than the 192 MB full BtbN zip.

yt-dlp.distribution: single-file executable (PyInstaller) from the tagged release

vapoursynth.note: Core ships as the pip 'vapoursynth' wheel (provides the Python API + VapourSynth.dll). vspipe is run from the core package.

plugins.note: VapourSynth plugins, installed into the bundled Python's Lib/site-packages via pip. Pinned to the versions currently shipped.

python_deps.note: Transitive / supporting Python packages present in the bundled site-packages (not all are directly invoked by Vapormint; some are plugin dependencies or the brain script's needs). Listed for reproducibility and audit; the assembly script pins only what it installs.

checks: vspipe --info scripts/runtime-probe.vpy -> all required plugin functions present
